paragraphs.source_en: The short autumn sun gradually sank. Cigarette stubs lay in a heap, and when one looked again, the charcoal fire in the brazier had long since gone out. Carefree as this company was in its idle chatter, even they now seemed somewhat to have lost their zest. First Dokusen rose and said, "It is quite late. I ought to be going home." The sitting room suddenly grew lonely, like the scene after a small troupe has finished its performance.
